# Varun Murugan P — GTM Engineer & AI Revenue Automation Architect

> Senior GTM Engineer specializing in building self-healing, deterministic revenue operating systems. Bridges business strategy and software engineering to turn manual RevOps bottlenecks into automated, high-converting pipelines using n8n, Clay, HubSpot, Python, and modern LLMs.

## Core Specializations
- **GTM Engineering & RevOps Automation**: Designing scalable, deterministic revenue architectures rather than fragile zap-chains.
- **Buying Signal Intelligence**: Real-time event monitoring, webhook ingestion, and algorithmic intent scoring (<120ms latency).
- **Multi-Provider Account & People Enrichment**: Chained waterfall enrichment via Clay, Apollo, Crustdata, and custom scrapers.
- **AI-Powered Lead & Reply Triage**: Fine-tuned classification (Positive, Objection, Unsubscribe, OOO) via GPT-4o with sub-3-minute SLA response alerts.
- **Deterministic State Machines**: Idempotent state stores in Google Sheets, Supabase, and HubSpot CRM with strict error-handling and dead-letter queues.

## Production Deliverables & Case Studies

1. [US Insurance Outbound System](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/projects/us-insurance-outbound-system/): Automated ABM outbound operating system with prospect qualification, n8n sequencing, and AI reply handling. (4 Workflows, 0 Errors, <3m Reply SLA).
2. [AI-Powered GTM Intelligence Hub](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/projects/gtm-intelligence-hub/): Prioritized high-intent outbound engine using real-time buying signals and automated enrichment. (94/100 Intent Score, 118ms enrichment, 4.2x reply rate).
3. [Autonomous Lead Response OS](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/projects/lead-response-os/): Sub-2-minute inbound lead qualification, enrichment, routing, and personalized booking sequencing. (1m 42s Speed-to-lead, 82% qualification rate).
4. [AI Newsletter Operations](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/projects/newsletter-automation/): End-to-end automated content curation, summary drafting, QA scoring, and multi-channel distribution. (7.5 hrs saved weekly, 99.4% publishing uptime).
5. [Outbound GTM Systems Audit](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/projects/outbound-gtm-audit/): Diagnostic audit identifying pipeline leakage, domain deliverability degradation, and CRM data decay across 12,000+ contacts. (43 actionable findings, 99.1% post-fix deliverability).
6. [AI Candidate Screening Engine](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/projects/candidate-screening/): Automated resume ingestion, rubric scoring, candidate evaluation, and automated feedback. (80% screening time reduction, 100% feedback rate).

## Technical Stack & Infrastructure
- **Workflow Orchestration**: n8n (Self-hosted & Cloud), Make, Custom Python Daemons
- **Data Enrichment & B2B Sourcing**: Clay, Apollo API, Crustdata, Hunter, Prospeo
- **CRM & Revenue Operations**: HubSpot CRM, Salesforce, Attio, Pipedrive
- **AI & LLM Orchestration**: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, LangChain, Prompt Engineering, Structured JSON Outputs
- **Languages & Databases**: Python, JavaScript/Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Google BigQuery, Google Sheets API
- **Infrastructure & Monitoring**: Webhooks, REST APIs, Dead-Letter Queues, Slack Alerting, Sentry

## Technical Insights & Engineering Publications (Blog)

- [What Is a GTM Engineer? A Practical Guide](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/blog/what-is-a-gtm-engineer/): Deep-dive into software engineering rigor, deterministic state machines, and AI replacing fragile RevOps hacks.
- [How to Build an AI-Powered Lead Response System](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/blog/how-to-build-an-ai-powered-lead-response-system/): Architectural breakdown of sub-2-minute inbound response: webhook ingress, Clay waterfall enrichment, GPT-4 qualification, and conditional calendar booking.
- [Inside an AI-Powered GTM Intelligence Hub](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/blog/inside-an-ai-powered-gtm-intelligence-hub/): Replacing cold outbound with real-time buying signal monitoring, intent scoring, and automated CRM synchronization.
- [Building an Automated Outbound System: Architecture and Lessons](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/blog/building-an-automated-outbound-system/): Engineering a 4-workflow ABM outbound operating system in n8n with Apollo qualification, idempotent state store, and AI reply classification.
- [GTM Engineering vs. RevOps: Roles, Responsibilities, and Tools](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/blog/gtm-engineering-vs-revops/): Objective comparison between GTM Engineering and traditional RevOps, explaining why high-growth companies need both.
- [Building GTM Automation Workflows with n8n](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/blog/building-gtm-automation-workflows-with-n8n/): Production guide to n8n for enterprise RevOps: self-hosted Docker, webhook security, rate limits, and custom JavaScript nodes.
- [How AI Automation Improves B2B Lead Generation](https://varunmurugan-gtm.vercel.app/blog/): [Scheduled Research] Transitioning from blast lists to signal-triggered precision outbound.
